sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: Duty crew on rounds onboard a ship underway noticed four robbers, on deck, with a long knife and immediately notified the OOW. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped. A search was made and found the steering gear room padlock was broken into. Nothing reported stolen.
